Legacy `docs/adr` trees for test_import_adr_mapping_multicontext (S05b): `core/` is copied to
`docs/adr/` and `billing/` to `services/billing/docs/adr/`. `core/` covers the status forms
(Nygard `## Status` accepted, superseded by a link, proposed; MADR `* Status: deprecated` with a
fenced look-alike; no status, with CRLF line endings); `billing/` has MADR frontmatter
`status: accepted`, a number that collides with `core/`, and its own README.md.
